description: chain_walk initializes nc_permitted=None and nc_excluded=empty regardless of the trust anchor cert's own NameConstraints extension. RFC 5280 §6.1.2 allows trust anchors to provide initial-permitted-subtrees and initial-excluded-subtrees. A trust anchor that has a NameConstraints extension meant to limit what its subordinate CAs can issue is silently ignored. The comment at line 1194 references 'PKIX-fr4' which does not exist in beads. → Any trust-anchor-imposed NC constraints have no effect.
title: Trust anchor NC extension ignored; chain_walk starts with unconstrained state
